name: assembly-newsh4-81
summary: Upper half of a horned episode-4 boss (its body and wings are assembly-newsh4-123, drawn 24 px lower), 72 x 28 px from three 2x2 pieces: a pointed grey helm with a glowing red slit down its ridge in the middle, over a dark machinery block carrying two red inverted-U pipes; on each side a grey shoulder pod (an upright cylinder with a red band) from whose top a long brown horn curves up and in, a thinner grey claw curling in towards the helm, a grey arm joining the pod to a bronze armour block over the wing root. Shape language: hard, faceted armour (the helm is a pointed, ridged shell; the bronze blocks are chamfered plates), with round parts where the sprite draws them round: the shoulder pods, their collars, the horns, the arms and the pipes.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: pointed grey head, cols 24-36, rows 9-18, pointing up the screen, widest at rows 13-16
the tallest part in the middle: about 5 px tall, with a crisp ridge along its centre line
hard faceted shell with flat sloping faces, not a smooth dome; darker bronze cap at its tip (rows 10-12)
features.note: The boss's head (concept: a pointed armoured helm). The baseline's grey face loft and bronze cap.

traits: red strip about 2 px wide down the helm's ridge, cols 29-31, rows 11-16
glows (emissive red), set on the ridge, visible from the game camera
features.note: The red crest in the sprite; the concept draws it as a glowing slot in the helm.

traits: long brown horn (both sides; left one framed), from the pod top at col 11, row 13 curving up and in to a point at cols 15-19, row 2
round in section, about 3 px wide, tapering to a sharp tip, rising above the pod towards its tip
lighter brown ridge along the top of each horn
features.note: The baseline's curved horns; the concept's big scythe horns on the shoulders.

traits: upright grey cylinder (both sides; left one framed) along the sprite's rows, cols 8-13 and rows 16-27, as tall as it is wide (about 4-5 px)
a red band around it at rows 21-24, standing slightly proud
a grey collar at its top end, rows 13-16, where the horn starts
features.note: The baseline's shoulder cylinder with its red band; the concept's red-ringed pod under each horn.

traits: thin grey curved blade (both sides; left one framed) from the pod at col 15, row 19 curling up and in to a point near the helm, col 23, row 10
tapers to a point at the inner tip; about 2 px wide at the root
rises towards its tip, clear of the bronze block below
features.note: The baseline's grey feelers; the concept draws them as the inner, smaller claws.

traits: bronze armour block over each wing root (both sides; left one framed), cols 17-23, rows 19-27
a hard plate about 3 px tall with chamfered top edges, the light catching its upper-left edge
a small bronze plate behind the pod's collar, cols 13-16, rows 16-21
features.note: The baseline's bronze blocks; the concept's bronze armour plates either side of the body.

traits: grey round arm (both sides) from the pod across to the bronze block, cols 12-18, rows 21-25
round in section, about 3 px wide and as tall
features.note: The baseline's grey arm sweep; the concept's grey connecting housing.

traits: two red inverted-U pipes on a dark machinery block below the helm, legs at cols 25-28 and 32-35, rows 21-27
each pipe a constant-diameter round tube (about 1.5 px) with a bend at its top, not a slab
the dark block under them about 3 px tall, below the helm, with a dark seam down the middle (col 30)
features.note: The baseline built these as pincers; the concept reads them as red coolant pipes on the dark body block.
